mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing propylthiouracil metabolism unpredictably, while propylthiouracil may increase lopinavir levels through competitive hepatic metabolism and both drugs carry hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) and protease inhibitor efficacy closely; consider alternative antiretroviral therapy or increased monitoring if combination cannot be avoided.
